title: indigo_test: urgent_tasks_are_counted reads AGENT_SCHEDULER_STATE.TOTAL without waiting
description: Seen in ticket d4fa9b11 (2026-11-16): the scheduler integration test urgent_tasks_are_counted in indigo_test/integration/test_agent_scheduler.c failed once with 'expected 2, got 3' and passed on rerun. Review of that ticket found the counter logic unchanged and the test reading TOTAL immediately with ASSERT_EQ_INT instead of waiting for the property to settle, an existing timing race. Fix the test to wait for the expected value (with a timeout) like the other waits in the suite, and confirm the scheduler's counting itself is correct (that 3 is never a valid final value). Reproduce by repeated runs of the scheduler integration suite.

outcome.summary: Pass. Root cause verified in indigo_drivers/agent_scheduler/indigo_agent_scheduler.c: finish_stop() STOP_DELETE sends 'Task ... aborted and deleted' (l.1381) before remove_task() (l.1382) decrements order_count; STATE is published only by update_counters() from refresh() (l.979-981) on the next process pass. The STOP_DELETE path does not call count_urgent(), so URGENT_DONE=1 and URGENT_FAILED=2 were already true before 'Cancelled' started (Flash, Broken, Too late); those waits therefore never synchronised with the deletion and an immediate TOTAL read could see 3 (Later, Stored urgent, Cancelled). After remove_task order_count is 2 and nothing re-adds the slot, so 3 is transient only. The wait does not hide a double count: wait_counter requires exactly 2 and fails after 5 s otherwise; the strict ASSERT_EQ_INT for DONE, FAILED and TOTAL are kept and read the same atomic STATE update (update_counters sets all five items in one indigo_update_property). delete_all_keeps_hooks...: uploads/urgent return on their property OK while TOTAL follows on the next refresh, so waiting for 6 is correct; the scheduler is stopped, so 6 is stable. Other immediate state_counter reads are safe: l.1992 DONE is in the same update as the awaited URGENT counters; l.1997/1998 follow a 500 ms settle after restart (the separate finding); l.2547 follows a wait for 128 with only rejected adds in between. Conventions: tabs, single-line calls, English comment; diff limited to the test file. Not rerun by the reviewer; relies on recorded whitespace and integration (104/104) checks. Note for the owner (out of scope): the save_config hypothesis is plausible - save_config() returns after only setting save_due when CONFIG is BUSY or config_mutex trylock fails, and agent_device_detach() calls it once with no retry; additionally indigo_save_property() itself trylocks config_mutex and silently drops a property when locked, so a late clear-history could be lost at shutdown. Not reproduced by the reviewer; wor

history.text: Fixed; building and running scheduler test outside flow check
Check command-1 started: make -j8 -C indigo_drivers/agent_scripting -f ../../Makefile.drv all && make -C indigo_test build/integration/test_agent_scheduler && cd indigo_test &
Check command-1 started: make -j8 -C indigo_drivers/agent_scripting -f ../../Makefile.drv all && make -C indigo_test build/integration/test_agent_scheduler && cd indigo_test &
Check command-1 started: make -j8 -C indigo_drivers/agent_scripting -f ../../Makefile.drv all && make -C indigo_test build/integration/test_agent_scheduler && cd indigo_test &

Root cause: the driver counts a running urgent task in order_count (TOTAL) until finish_stop() calls remove_task(); update_counters() runs later from refresh(). The message 'Task Cancelled aborted and deleted' is sent before remove_task, and the URGENT_FAILED=2 wait passes without involving TOTAL, so an immediate read of TOTAL could see the transient 3 (Later, Stored urgent, Cancelled). Test race, not a wrong final count. Fix: wait_counter(TOTAL,2,5) before the DONE/FAILED/TOTAL asserts; same immediate-read fix for TOTAL==6 in delete_all_keeps_hooks_and_needs_a_stopped_scheduler. Strict asserts kept. Repro: single failure of the original not reproduced in 30 isolated runs (0/30), fixed 0/30; under 8 busy loops original failed 1/15 but at a different line (see separate finding), fixed 0/15. Full suite 104/104 passed. Separate finding: original line 1997 (after clear + restart, URGENT_DONE expected 0 got 1): save_config() may defer (CONFIG BUSY or config_mutex trylock fails) and detach calls it only once, so a clear can be lost at shutdown under load.
